episode_summary: Kim Rittberg discusses the importance of integrating personal content into social media strategies to enhance engagement and build credibility. She emphasizes the use of video content, both long and short-form, and shares tactics for maintaining client relationships during downtime. The episode provides actionable insights for real estate agents looking to strengthen their personal brand and client connections.
